text:
sara: FYI opening escalation — fintechX sees decryption failures after CMK rotation; high retry rates and billing spike. Root error in our logs: InvalidCiphertextException: EncryptionContext does not match. Can we triage? (ticket #7894)

 tom: do we have raw request the proxy sent?

 sara: pasted sanitized request:
---BEGIN REQUEST---
POST /v1/kms/decrypt
Host: kms-proxy.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer ******
X-KMS-KeyId: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-OLDKEY
X-Encryption-Context: "{\"tenant\":\"tenant-42\",\"env\":\"prod\"}"
Body (base64): AQAB... (ciphertext)
---END REQUEST---

 meera: that header looks wrong: we are sending a JSON string as a single header value. AWS KMS expects an EncryptionContext map (string->string). If we pass a single JSON string it’ll compare and fail.

 dave: why only tenant-42 and only after rotation?

 meera: likely because when the key was rotated the underlying CMK changed and KMS validates the context against the recorded context for the data key. Previously our proxy might have been tolerated or cache matched.

 jorge: any recent change to kms-proxy?

 sara: yes, minor change 2026-03-05: stringify JSON for Encryption-Context header to avoid header encoding; deployed then. Customer rotated on 2026-03-06.

 meera: bingo. Bug introduced by stringification. Console Decrypt may succeed because AWS console SDK passes proper map or they omitted context. Proxy path was wrong.

 tom: Mitigation plan?

 jorge: immediate: 1) revert/patch proxy to deserialize X-Encryption-Context JSON strings into a map before calling KMS; 2) flush per-tenant key cache when alias->key-id changes; 3) canary deploy patched proxy for tenant-42, then cutover; 4) add alert for per-tenant InvalidCiphertextException surge.

 dave: I'll set up routing rule to send tenant-42 to patched instance after tests. Also add CloudTrail script to extract Decrypt calls and key-id timeline for billing report.

 meera: I'll open a PR with unit tests for header parsing and add defensive validation that rejects single-string context without attempting to call KMS.

 sara: customer message draft: "we identified a proxy encoding bug that caused encryption-context to be serialized as a single string; we will roll a hotfix and perform a controlled cutover tonight. We'll provide CSV of failed calls and cost impact." :thumbsup:

 tom: I'll prepare the billing impact CSV and share ETA for cutover. Also tagging eng-sre for monitoring.

 kms-proxy-bot: deploy pipeline: patch branch -> CI green -> canary staging -> canary prod (manual approval required).

 jorge: follow-ups (owners):
- meera: hotfix + tests
- dave: cache flush + routing rule
- eng-sre: alert for InvalidCiphertextException spikes
- tom: customer bill & CloudTrail extract
- sara: attach ticket + CloudTrail snippets

 sara: thanks all, will update customer and set up cutover window tonight (22:00 PDT).
